## Reading

- Recon 2 (V): diverging legs 59 of 61 step (split 29/30, merge 30/31); straight legs 16 of 61; trunks never with a crossing as other end (0 of 20). Counts below are (track, node end) rows with a used S-bend in the stretch.
- T1 (7 used): diverging legs 3 of 10 (split 3 of 5, merge 0 of 5); direction of the used ones: away 2, toward 1. Straight legs 1 of 8; trunks 2 of 8 (both at a port; merge trunks 0 of 5). Port: 2 used S-bends (both on trunks); crossing-crossing: 2.
- T2 (46 used): diverging legs 12 of 20 (split 6 of 10, merge 6 of 10); used bends at diverging ends: toward 6, away 6. Straight legs 7 of 16; of the used bends at straight ends, toward 7, away 3. Trunks 10 of 16 (port 7 of 12, crossing 2 of 3, node 1 of 1). Port S-bends: 12; crossing-crossing: 10. T2 uses 2 or more S-bends in one stretch on 12 stretches; T1 on 0.
- Neither drawing has V's pattern (diverging nearly always, straight rarely, merge diverging 30 of 31): T1 diverging splits 3 of 5 and merges 0 of 5; T2 about half of each role.
- Fray: T1 3 of 9, T2 15 of 18; join: T1 3 of 11, T2 11 of 22; copy/row node: T1 0 of 6, T2 3 of 12.
- Some T2 S-bend lengths are large (900 to 2037): the CP-SAT solution there is a long diagonal, not a local step.
